newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT ISRAEL IN SOCCER FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SWEDEN BEAT ISRAEL IN SOCCER FRIENDLY.

text.p: Sweden beat Israel 1-0 in an international soccer friendly on Wednesday, the winning goal coming from Andreas Andersson in the 68th minute.
Andersson beat two defenders on the right side of the Israeli goal and fired beyond the reach of goalkeeper Rafi Cohen.
The Israelis had dominated the first half and missed three good chances.
But Sweden took the initiative after the break as the hosts faded and defensive holes began to appear, one of which was found by Andersson.
"We gave the Israelis too much space in the first half, we were disorganised and couldn't find our rhythm," said Swedish coach Tommy Svensson.
"But in the second half we settled down and didn't allow Israel to develop their game. This was a very good test for us," he said.
Israel coach Shlomo Scharf said: "We were naive in front of goal and our players lack the conviction and the stamina to play at this level."
